Problem Statement:
Write a program to implement a double-ended queue (deque) using an array. 
Input Description:
First line: size of deque
Next lines: operations like insertFront X, insertRear X, deleteFront, deleteRear, display
Ends with “exit” 
Output Description:
Deque contents after display command. 
Sample Input:
5
insertRear 1
insertRear 2
insertFront 3
deleteRear
display
exit 
Sample Output:
3 1
